question: The ‘Our Children Cultural Space’ (ECuNHi – Espacio Cultural Nuestros Hijos), set up by the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo association in Buenos Aires, is an important space dedicated to remembrance, culture, education and the promotion of human rights in Argentina.

For decades, ECuNHi has helped to preserve the memory of the victims of the military dictatorship and to run cultural and civic activities open to society as a whole. However, following the ideological budget cuts imposed by the Argentinian far-right government, which particularly affect human rights organisations, ECuNHi is currently facing serious financial difficulties.

The situation is exacerbated by the worrying condition of the building, which requires urgent infrastructure work to ensure users remain safe and its work can carry on. In view of this, can the Commission say whether EU financial instruments, particular in the fields of culture, historical memory, civil society and fundamental rights, can be accessed by an organisation like ECuNHi?
